description: utopia-php/async 0.2: Promises/A+ promises over Sync, Swoole coroutine, Amp and React adapters (Promise::async, run, map, all, race, any, allSettled, delay, timeout), timers (Timer::after, tick, clear, clearAll, exists, getTimers over Swoole, Amp, React and a sync fallback), and parallel execution of closures in worker threads or processes (Parallel::run, all, map, forEach, pool). Rust: utopia-async, the same three facades over one engine adapter (Tokio) that every crate uses for tasks, timers and I/O. In progress: the facades and the engine are ported and tested in the crate; the compat operations and cases are not written yet.

waivers.Utopia\\Async\\Serializer::*: PHP runtime plumbing: serialises closures (opis/closure) to ship them to worker processes and threads. Rust's Parallel runs closures on the engine's thread pool, which shares memory, so nothing is serialised.
waivers.Utopia\\Async\\GarbageCollection::*: PHP runtime plumbing: triggers PHP's cycle collector in long-lived workers past a memory threshold. Rust frees memory deterministically.
waivers.Utopia\\Async\\Parallel\\Pool\\*: PHP runtime plumbing: pools of Swoole threads or processes and ext-parallel runtimes that receive serialised tasks. Rust's Parallel uses the engine's blocking pool.
waivers.Utopia\\Async\\Parallel::createPool: PHP runtime plumbing: an explicit pool of Swoole workers. The engine's blocking pool is sized by utopia_async::Builder::blocking_threads.
waivers.Utopia\\Async\\Parallel::shutdown: PHP runtime plumbing: stops the default worker pool's processes. Rust's blocking pool stops with its runtime.
waivers.Utopia\\Async\\Parallel::*Config: PHP runtime plumbing: serialisation limits, worker polling intervals and GC thresholds of PHP's worker processes, with no Rust counterpart.
waivers.Utopia\\Async\\Promise::*Config: PHP runtime plumbing: the polling sleeps PHP's await() loops back off with. A Rust future is woken by the engine instead of polled.
waivers.Utopia\\Async\\Promise::setAdapter: The engine is chosen at compile time (utopia_async::Engine, a cargo feature), so every call goes straight to it.
waivers.Utopia\\Async\\Timer::setAdapter: The engine is chosen at compile time (utopia_async::Engine, a cargo feature), so every call goes straight to it.
waivers.Utopia\\Async\\Parallel::setAdapter: The engine is chosen at compile time (utopia_async::Engine, a cargo feature), so every call goes straight to it.
